_doc: Config for expansion 3.1 (Warren, Forest, McKean transfer). Path specs resolve through expkit (path_for / area_dir / exp_dir / abs). {area} fills from --area. Items under assumed are not held yet; scripts fail with a message naming them. 3.2 reuses these scripts with config_3_2.json.
_margin_note: User accepted the default 0.03 recall per arm on 2026-11-06 (take defaults). Change freely. Never from fold spread.

multiplicity._note: User default 2026-11-06. Holm over the per-arm primaries only (fw_3_1 primary per arm). K30, density-scaled, super-block and the low-density stratum are reported, never gated. Family step: 3.0 _transfer_holm_gate.py over the three score JSONs.

eligibility._note: density_rule 9t_p5 = blocks below the 5th percentile of 9t block ground density form a labelled low-density stratum (fw_3_2 section 3). A number here overrides it.

forest._note: assumed. Forest D20 window (20 tiles, 0.91 GB) listed in lidar_win_download_list_us.csv, not fetched. The dest folder mixes windows, so filter by the window tile list.

il_cumberland._note: assumed. 3.3 S5 area-gate target (Illinois_Cumberland window, 80 tiles, 3.61 GB). Not fetched. Fetch is a user step.

outputs._note: Heavy rasters (>=100 MB) stay under the expansion data/ (gitignored). Move to data/{area}/derived/05/ once the lead adds a .gitignore rule for it.

reference._note: Scoring reference is the 3.0 reference tables (review F02 / F08). They stamp ek.policy_for, the footprint (all 144 blocks after the G-02 fill) and the checkpoint lineage. Both are provisional today (historical CV5 pit, buffer-0 pad), so 3.1 scores are descriptive until P1 isolated models exist. blocks_csv and summary_json (3.3 S1) feed only the projected-width design tool and the prereg draft.

isolated_ckpt.schema: torch checkpoint, keys state_dict, channels, mu, sd, epoch

isolated_reference_blocks.schema: CSV block_id, n_truth, hits, hits_k30, area_km2 at K=40 under the declared policy

derived_buffer.schema: P1 buffer_derivation_9t.json, read with ek.read_buffer(task) (buffer_m_by_task, or buffer_m for pit)

truth.schema: GeoPackage, layers pit_inside (floors, id pit_inside_id), pit_full (rims), pad (id pad_id); EPSG:6346; complete blind annotation of test blocks

truth_recheck.schema: same layers as truth, drawn independently on the recheck blocks

prereg.schema: Markdown preregistration, committed before scoring; its SHA-256 is recorded in the score run

flight_dates.schema: CSV program, start_date, end_date, leaf_state, source_url
flight_dates.from: USGS project metadata XML (manifest D1, manual fetch)

_fallback_note: Used only with --provisional-buffer before P1 S4 exists. 192 m is the pad patch support named in protocol section 3 rule 4, not a derived buffer.
_policy_note: Proposal cutoff, min blob, IoU, match order and K come from ek.policy_for(task) through the 3.0 scorer. iou_tau and min_blob_m2 here mirror it and are not read by the scorer.
